decision: Retain the junction-based detector as the current schematic building block, disconnected from pad enables. Normal-reference DC trip spread improves, but reproducible low-voltage output, shutdown latency and retained output charge still require a reset-dominant local clamp/discharge and controlled restart. DC trip values do not qualify pad safety.
scope: Transistor/resistor DC corner screen with a 500 fF declared load. Logic-high threshold is 0.7 times supply, not proof that lower voltages cannot partially enable a pad. No hysteresis, reference generation, transient reset/brownout, mismatch, extraction or connected-pad safety qualification.

transient.scope: Typical FET/BJT and resistor models,27C,500fF output load. Duration is sampled integration, not a rigorous timing bound. Supply/reference/reset are prescribed external transitions; output is generated by the physical circuit. High output during invalid supply and retained output after power loss remain failures to resolve. No pad gate fanout, layout, ESD or device-survival qualification.

rejected_mos_control: The prior MOS-threshold floor asserted below2.5V in ff/fs with degraded reference and required about3.0V in ss at1V reference; not selected. Reproduce with floor_kind=mos,floor_ratio=3.2.

connected_receive_diagnostic.scope: Same extracted RX/USB pad, retained 3.3V peers and 500fF additional control load. Schematic supervisor and ideal control wires; no layout/fanout or latch/blanking sequencer. FS_HIGH_P and PULLUP_N are simultaneous generic branch exercises, not a legal USB transaction. Separate pad supply probe retains displacement/backfeed current even when supervisor consumes supply current. Bias/reference and supply waveforms remain explicit fixture inputs.

extended_brownout_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic 10k supervisor only; same retained pad branches and peers. Early supply backfeed decays, but settled pads remain near 1.55V instead of the unloaded external divider level of 3V. The remaining current path is unidentified. Not steady-state leakage or safety qualification.

stronger_discharge_diagnostic.scope: Typical FET/BJT and resistor models,27C,500fF output load. Duration is sampled integration, not a rigorous timing bound. Supply/reference/reset are prescribed external transitions; output is generated by the physical circuit. High output during invalid supply and retained output after power loss remain failures to resolve. No pad gate fanout, layout, ESD or device-survival qualification.

integration_decision: Do not adopt 10k supervisor: active current exceeds monitor allocation. Late brownout tracing identifies about 1.0603mA from PAD_P through four steering diodes into ESD_RAIL, while functional branch terminal currents are at nanoamp scale. Prioritize protection-rail holding/release behavior under ordinary externally powered peers before more supervisor tuning. No corrected protection circuit or safety qualification yet.
